main.title: The Sopranos
main.subtitle: Tony Soprano brings his two families into the same troubled life
main.summary: David Chase's The Sopranos begins with a New Jersey mobster seeking help for panic attacks. James Gandolfini plays Tony Soprano, whose therapy sessions open a second view onto his family and criminal life. The series premiered on HBO in the United States on 10 January 1999, with Edie Falco as his wife Carmela and Lorraine Bracco as psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi.

cards.heading: A mobster in therapy
cards.text: David Chase's The Sopranos begins with a New Jersey mobster seeking help for panic attacks. James Gandolfini plays Tony Soprano, whose therapy sessions open a second view onto his family and criminal life. The series premiered on HBO in the United States on 10 January 1999, with Edie Falco as his wife Carmela and Lorraine Bracco as psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi.

cards.heading: Two families, shared consequences
cards.text: The distinction between Tony's two families rarely holds. A decision at home can become a problem for his crew, while criminal money shapes the comfort and compromises of the household. Therapy lets him describe these pressures in language that sometimes reveals and sometimes protects him. Scenes of meals, arguments and routine business give the relationships time to become familiar. Violence then arrives inside a world whose ordinary habits the audience already knows.

cards.heading: Living with the characters
cards.text: Gandolfini's performance makes Tony's charm and anger difficult to separate. Chase allows comedy, dreams and uncomfortable silences to interrupt the expected progress of a crime story. The ensemble carries lives that extend beyond the boss, including Carmela's accommodation with the source of the family's security. Following these people over six seasons made gradual change as important as a single dramatic event. By the end of its run, the series had helped establish long-form cable drama as a major creative centre for television.

main.title: Roberto Benigni: Life Is Beautiful at the Oscars
main.summary: On 21 March 1999, Roberto Benigni won Best Actor for Life Is Beautiful, which also won the Foreign Language Film award for Italy.

cards.heading: Roberto Benigni: Life Is Beautiful at the Oscars
cards.text:
Roberto Benigni won Best Actor for Life Is Beautiful at the Academy Awards on March 21, 1999. The film also won the Foreign Language Film award for Italy. Written, directed by and starring Benigni, the 1997 Holocaust comedy-drama brought international recognition to the Italian filmmaker and comedian.

Benigni began his screen career with Berlinguer, I Love You in 1977, which he wrote and Giuseppe Bertolucci directed. His directorial debut, Tu mi turbi in 1983, also introduced Nicoletta Braschi as an actor. He subsequently directed and starred in films including Nothing Left to Do But Cry, The Little Devil, Johnny Stecchino and The Monster before Life Is Beautiful.

main.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
main.subtitle: An escaped prisoner brings Harry closer to his family's past
main.summary: Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban, and Harry is warned that he may be the fugitive's next target. The third novel surrounds Hogwarts with Dementors, guards whose presence can overwhelm people with despair. Their effect on Harry is particularly severe, drawing him towards memories of his parents' deaths. Meanwhile, new teacher Remus Lupin gives practical lessons in defending against dark creatures. Published in Britain on 8 July 1999, the book gradually connects the immediate threat to relationships formed by an earlier generation at the school.

cards.heading: A prisoner at large
cards.text: Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban, and Harry is warned that he may be the fugitive's next target. The third novel surrounds Hogwarts with Dementors, guards whose presence can overwhelm people with despair. Their effect on Harry is particularly severe, drawing him towards memories of his parents' deaths. Meanwhile, new teacher Remus Lupin gives practical lessons in defending against dark creatures. Published in Britain on 8 July 1999, the book gradually connects the immediate threat to relationships formed by an earlier generation at the school.

cards.heading: Learning to face fear
cards.text: Harry has to work with accounts of the past that are incomplete or shaped by loyalty and fear. The story lets new evidence change the meaning of people and incidents already encountered, making recognition part of the mystery. Lupin's teaching also turns protection into something Harry must learn through practice rather than inherit through fame. Ordinary school concerns remain important: permission to visit Hogsmeade, Hermione's crowded timetable and Hagrid's first lessons all become involved in the unfolding investigation, giving small details consequences much later in the year.

main.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
main.subtitle: A stolen sword exposes desires held beneath discipline
main.summary: Ang Lee's Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon brings a story of love and restraint into the wuxia tradition of martial-arts adventure. Chow Yun-fat and Michelle Yeoh play experienced warriors whose lives are unsettled by a stolen sword and a talented young woman. Released in 2000, the film combines Yuen Wo-ping's action choreography with relationships shaped by duty and unspoken feeling.

cards.heading: A sword and two generations
cards.text: Ang Lee's Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon brings a story of love and restraint into the wuxia tradition of martial-arts adventure. Chow Yun-fat and Michelle Yeoh play experienced warriors whose lives are unsettled by a stolen sword and a talented young woman. Released in 2000, the film combines Yuen Wo-ping's action choreography with relationships shaped by duty and unspoken feeling.

cards.heading: The freedom skill cannot settle
cards.text: Li Mu Bai intends to leave his fighting life behind, but the disappearance of Green Destiny draws him back. Yu Shu Lien's investigation brings her close to Jen, an aristocrat preparing for an arranged marriage. The older pair have learned to contain their desires; Jen resists the future chosen for her. Their encounters make the fights arguments about freedom and responsibility. Skill gives the younger woman opportunities to escape, but it cannot decide what she should do with them.

cards.heading: Movement as an argument
cards.text: The action changes character with its surroundings. Rooftop pursuits make the city a field of movement, an exchange among weapons tests control and adaptation, and the bamboo forest gives a confrontation an almost weightless rhythm. These changes let physical technique express the differences between the characters. Tan Dun's score, featuring Yo-Yo Ma's cello, brings another register of longing to the adventure. The film won four Academy Awards, including the foreign-language film award.

main.title: Nokia 3310
main.summary: The Nokia 3310 is a discontinued GSM mobile phone by Nokia.

cards.heading: Nokia 3310
cards.text:
The Nokia 3310 is a discontinued GSM mobile phone by Nokia. It was announced on 1 September 2000, and released in the fourth quarter of the year, replacing the popular Nokia 3210. It is one of the most successful phones ever made, with 126 million units sold worldwide, and being one of Nokia's most iconic devices. The phone is still widely acclaimed and has gained a cult status due to its reputation for durability and long battery life.

The Nokia 3310 was produced at factories in Finland and Hungary. Several variants of the 3310 have been released, including the Nokia 3315, 3320, 3330, 3350, 3360, 3390 and 3395. The 3315s were produced in South Korea for the Asia-Pacific market.

The phone was succeeded by the Nokia 3410 and Nokia 3510. A new mobile phone based on the 3310 design was launched in 2017; this new Nokia 3310 model comes with a comprehensive update over its predecessor, with a 2.4" color display, a 2 Megapixel rear camera, and a microSD slot.

main.title: USB flash drive
main.summary: USB flash drives went on sale in late 2000, combining rewritable flash memory with a USB connector in a pocket-sized device.

cards.heading: USB flash drive
cards.text: USB flash drives went on sale in late 2000, combining rewritable flash memory with a USB connector in a pocket-sized device. Files could be stored, backed up and carried between computers without a separate drive or fragile exposed disc surface. With no moving parts, the devices offered a durable alternative to floppy disks and CDs. Early models held around eight megabytes, while later capacities reached terabytes. Their small size and increasing capacity made the USB stick a familiar object in everyday computing, turning large collections of documents into something easy to carry.

main.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
main.subtitle: An international tournament changes Harry's fourth year
main.summary: Harry is too young to enter the Triwizard Tournament, yet the enchanted cup unexpectedly names him as a competitor. He must face dangerous tasks alongside older champions from Hogwarts and two visiting schools. Preparation, help from friends and the uncertainty of who placed his name in the cup drive the year forward. J.K. Rowling's fourth novel was released on 8 July 2000, with Bloomsbury and Scholastic publishing it on the same day in Britain and the United States.

cards.heading: An unwanted champion
cards.text: Harry is too young to enter the Triwizard Tournament, yet the enchanted cup unexpectedly names him as a competitor. He must face dangerous tasks alongside older champions from Hogwarts and two visiting schools. Preparation, help from friends and the uncertainty of who placed his name in the cup drive the year forward. J.K. Rowling's fourth novel was released on 8 July 2000, with Bloomsbury and Scholastic publishing it on the same day in Britain and the United States.

cards.heading: The world beyond Hogwarts
cards.text: The Quidditch World Cup and the visiting schools widen the magical world beyond Harry's usual classrooms and rivalries. The tournament puts him on public display, while newspaper coverage turns private events into stories he cannot control. Friendship becomes harder to manage under that attention: Ron's jealousy and the awkwardness surrounding the Yule Ball belong to the same school year as the dangerous tasks. As the competition progresses, its ceremonial rules and celebrations increasingly coexist with signs of a threat that reaches beyond the grounds of Hogwarts.

main.title: Discovery
main.summary: Discovery is the second studio album by the French electronic music duo Daft Punk, released on 12 March 2001 by Virgin Records.

cards.heading: Discovery
cards.text:
Discovery is the second studio album by the French electronic music duo Daft Punk, released on 12 March 2001 by Virgin Records. It moved from the Chicago house of their first album, Homework (1997), to a house style inspired by disco, post-disco, garage house, and R&B. Thomas Bangalter of Daft Punk described Discovery as an exploration of song structures, musical forms, and childhood nostalgia, compared to the "raw" electronic music of Homework.

Discovery was recorded at Bangalter's home in Paris between 1998 and 2000. It features extensive sampling; some samples are from older records, while others were created by Daft Punk. The electronic musicians Romanthony, Todd Edwards, and DJ Sneak collaborated on some tracks. For the music videos, Daft Punk developed a concept that merged science fiction with the entertainment industry. Inspired by their childhood love for Japanese anime, the duo collaborated with Leiji Matsumoto to produce Interstella 5555: The 5tory of the 5ecret 5tar 5ystem, an anime film with Discovery as the soundtrack.

main.title: iPod
main.summary: The iPod is a discontinued series of portable media players and multi-purpose mobile devices that were designed and marketed by Apple from 2001 to 2022.

cards.heading: iPod
cards.text:
The iPod is a discontinued series of portable media players and multi-purpose mobile devices that were designed and marketed by Apple from 2001 to 2022. The first version was released on November 10, 2001, 10 months after the Macintosh version of iTunes was released. Apple has sold an estimated 450 million iPods. Apple officially discontinued the iPod product line on May 10, 2022. The iPod is the longest-running product discontinued by Apple, with a total lifespan of over 20 years.

Some versions of the iPod can serve as external data storage devices, like other digital music players. Prior to macOS 10.15, Apple's iTunes software (and other alternative software) could be used to transfer music, photos, videos, games, contact information, e-mail settings, Web bookmarks, and calendars to the devices supporting these features from computers using certain versions of Apple macOS and Microsoft Windows operating systems.

main.title: Spirited Away
main.summary: Hayao Miyazaki's Spirited Away appeared in 2001, taking a young girl into a world of spirits.

cards.heading: Spirited Away
cards.text: Hayao Miyazaki's Spirited Away appeared in 2001, taking a young girl into a world of spirits. After her parents are transformed into pigs, Chihiro works in the witch's bathhouse while searching for a way to free them and return home. The setting draws on kami from Japanese Shinto folklore. Miyazaki developed the story with the ten-year-old daughter of a friend in mind, giving a girl of that age its central role. Studio Ghibli began production in 2000, with Toshio Suzuki producing the animated film.
